meta.label: Modelled panel, not fieldwork
meta.method: Simulated respondents. Each answer share is set from the team's real survey of 17 users blended with a published prior (survey), from a published study (anchored) or from a stated team assumption (assumed), then sampled so the panel behaves like a real sample of that size.

real.method: Anonymous online form shared by the team; 16 tick-box questions
real.sample: 13 of 17 are under 25 and 12 of 17 live in Mumbai or Navi Mumbai, so it describes young urban users and not dermatology patients
